retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 那個孩子放學後很興奮能在雪地裡玩。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: We celebrated my grandmother's birthday with a big family dinner.

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他無論到哪裡都有交朋友的能力。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他把文件影印了兩份。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他解釋這台新洗衣機怎麼用。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He felt proud when he finished the marathon.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他跑完馬拉松時感到很自豪。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He does the grocery shopping online to save time.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他在線上買雜貨以節省時間。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He loves to collect baseball cards.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他很喜歡收集棒球卡。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: We like to hang out at the coffee shop after class.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 我們下課後喜歡去咖啡店閒晃。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: The teenager practiced riding a skateboard in the park.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 那名青少年在公園練習滑滑板。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He warned the little one that the bench was wet.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他提醒小朋友長椅是濕的。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He was honest and returned the lost wallet.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他很誠實，把遺失的錢包歸還了。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He dried both hands with a clean towel.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他用乾淨的毛巾擦乾雙手。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 那道舊傷疤在他手臂上留下了痕跡。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He opened the big dictionary to check a word.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他翻開大字典查一個字。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He failed his driving test when he knocked over a cone.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他撞倒三角錐，駕照考試失敗了。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他加入了學校的攝影社。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He usually wakes up at six thirty every morning.

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He drank a cup of coffee to stay awake during the long meeting.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他喝了一杯咖啡好在冗長的會議中保持清醒。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他向孩子解釋桌上每件物品的定義。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He sealed the cardboard box with strong tape.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他用牢固的膠帶封好紙箱。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He expected rain, so he packed an umbrella.

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He placed the letter inside a blue envelope.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他把信放進藍色信封裡。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: My grandfather was a soldier when he was young.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 我爺爺年輕的時候是個軍人。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He set a good example by helping the old neighbor carry groceries.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他幫年長的鄰居提雜貨，樹立了好榜樣。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: She was so excited to put on her new school uniform.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 她迫不及待地穿上她的新制服。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He used a pin to fasten the photo to the board.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他用圖釘把照片固定在板子上。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: The teacher asked the students to repeat the sentence after him.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 老師要學生們跟著他再說一次那個句子。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: Only a few drops of rain fell before the sky cleared up.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 只下了幾滴雨，天空就放晴了。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: My grandfather had a mild heart attack but recovered well.
retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 我爺爺輕微心臟病發作，但後來恢復得很好。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他在表格底部簽下名字。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionEn: He rubbed both temples, hoping the headache would go away.

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 這件襯衫是他特賣時買的最後一件商品。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他發現拼圖中的錯誤並加以修正。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 他在一家電腦公司當工程師。

retainedLV1Drafts.captionZh: 這個包包的價錢是另一個的兩倍。
